text: Chapter 16: The Royal Dragon Bloodline@Chaos in the Valley
■Next Mission\nMove from Sollys Plains to\nFreedos's Residence to start.

After arriving in Opia Twinpalms by ark, Freedos asks you to
find a material called Ancient Eternal Charcoal.
However, you have no idea where to find it.
It's a shot in the dark, but your best bet is to start
looking in Gubise Valley since it's right in front of you!

You find nothing in Gubise Valley. Frustrated, Pelulu and
Zianga begin to argue. Drawn by the noise, a group of
weredragons suddenly appears.
As the weredragons raise
their weapons, you ready yourself for combat.
You have no choice now. Show them what you're capable of!

After winning the fight, you notice the weredragon soldiers
are exceptionally thin. According to their story, an evil
spirit that has settled in the area is preventing crops from
growing in the village. Let's head into the depths of
Gubise Valley and drive out the evil spirit!

Kipina, the evil spirit causing the villagers to suffer, is
engulfed in flames. She's dangerous!
Seeming highly displeased, she attacks you!
Defeat her with everything you've got!
[[N]]Go to Gubise Valley from Sollys Plains
